known_boundaries.ai_explicit_page_context_failure: A requested page_id context failure is returned as an error; the handler does not silently use other pages.
known_boundaries.ai_fallback_error_redaction: AI fallback_errors are limited to an empty list, AI provider unavailable, or AI provider temporarily unavailable; provider exceptions and filesystem paths are not exposed.
known_boundaries.anonymous_public_form_scope: The route accepts path block_id values, while the application auth exemption currently covers only a single path segment.
known_boundaries.best_effort_degradation_fields: Primary success payloads are preserved while degraded and sorted degraded_sources report inbox=outlook_notifications; search=page_content; overview=calendar_events,second_brain_sources,second_brain_thoughts,session_page_bindings; AI ask=related_page_content.
known_boundaries.filename_os_error_redaction: Filename-bearing OS exceptions are classified as sanitized internal_error responses.
known_boundaries.notion_prefix_http_errors: Once Flask error dispatch is reached, unknown routes, disallowed methods, and oversized requests under Notion API prefixes use scoped JSON errors; application auth or security checks may run first.
known_boundaries.public_page_failure_text: Public page rendering failures return fixed generic text; they do not reflect exception details.
known_boundaries.route_scoped_render_and_file_errors: Private/public file sending and public HTML rendering execute inside their route error boundaries.
